main_axis.headline: You move by gathering specialized knowledge, testing it against your own judgment, and looking for a practical return.
main_axis.body: Indirect Resource—the habit of researching alone and pursuing offbeat knowledge—sets your pace: you gather context before acting. Rob Wealth—competition among peers and scrambling for resources—adds comparison and independent judgment, while Direct Wealth—steady income and savings built bit by bit—and Indirect Wealth—a nose for opportunities and mobilizing resources—keep practical returns in view. Direct Resource—systems, credentials, and backing—adds a route through formal knowledge; Seven Killings—external pressure and hard demands—adds a response to firm demands.
main_axis.latent: Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, Direct Resource, Hurting Officer, Companion

Rob Wealth and Direct Wealth are tied at 6: hour stem 辛 is Rob Wealth and year stem 乙 is Direct Wealth; hidden 辛 in 丑 is Rob Wealth and hidden 乙 in 辰 is Direct Wealth. The next weights are Seven Killings 4; Indirect Wealth and Direct Resource 3 each; Hurting Officer 2; Companion 1. Visible element counts are earth 3, wood 2, metal 2, fire 1, and water 0; water is hidden / not shown among the visible characters, with hidden 癸 classified as Hurting Officer in 丑 and 辰.

core_loop.headline: You turn private research into a practical return by testing it against people and real-world terms.
core_loop.flow: You build a private read of a subject, then compare it with other people's priorities and the terms of an opportunity. A finding becomes usable when you give it a repeatable form for steady returns while still noticing openings that call for resources to be mobilized.
core_loop.driver: The 庚 day master is medium strength, and the engine lists metal and earth as favorable-element candidates. Indirect Resource is heavy at 10, while Rob Wealth and Direct Wealth each carry 6; the chart also has Indirect Wealth at 3. Visible earth is 3 and metal is 2, while visible water is 0.
core_loop.leak:
You can keep researching and comparing options after a workable choice is available, so a useful idea may stay private or unfinished.
In the ten years starting around age 38 (the 壬午 pillar), water becomes more visible in the timing, which can shift the emphasis toward sharing what you know rather than keeping it in research.
Set a decision rule before research begins: name the question, the evidence needed, and the point at which you will deliver a usable result.

structure_type.name: the practical researcher
structure_type.one_line: You first build a private map of unfamiliar material, then use your judgment to decide which parts can support a practical return.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when you must investigate unfamiliar material and make a grounded choice with practical consequences; weakest when you must produce a steady stream of polished public-facing work on a fixed cadence.
capability_source.text: Your strength comes from combining solitary inquiry with attention to usable terms and concrete returns. In a cross-team planning meeting, you can compare vendor proposals, check what each promise depends on, and present a brief that gives the group a defensible choice.
capability_source.evidence: Indirect Resource weighs 10 and Direct Resource 3, with hidden 戊 in 寅, 辰, and 巳 classified as Indirect Resource and hidden 己 in 丑 classified as Direct Resource. Direct Wealth weighs 6 and Indirect Wealth 3, supporting attention to steady returns as well as opportunities. Output weights are Hurting Officer 2 and Eating God 0; visible water is 0, with hidden 癸 in 丑 and 辰 classified as Hurting Officer.

structure_fingerprint: You gather information, test it, and use judgment to turn findings into practical returns.
